rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for picking or selecting something.

example.english: Then I choose the red one.
example.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 gaan2 hung4 sik1 go2 gin6 laa1

rows.note: Use this as a more neutral or formal alternative to 揀 when selecting among options.

example.english: This restaurant has many dishes to choose from.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳有好多菜式可以選擇。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 hou2 do1 coi3 sik1 ho2 ji5 syun2 zaak6

rows.note: Use this when choosing means deciding to act in a particular way.

example.english: I choose to start exercising tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我決定聽日開始做運動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ting1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when someone is elected or selected for an official position.

example.english: The students voted to choose a new class monitor.
example.traditional: 學生投票選出咗新班長。
example.jyutping: hok6 saang1 tau4 piu3 syun2 ceot1 zo2 san1 baan1 zoeng2
